landing.subtext: Short lessons and friendly quizzes from the NCERT Maths Mela book. Made for any phone.

sample.prompt: A slice of pizza looks most like which shape?
sample.explanation: A pizza slice has 3 corners and 3 sides, like a triangle.

landing.tried: That is how every lesson works.
landing.lessonTitle: Every lesson works the same way.
landing.readText: A short idea in simple words, with an example from everyday life.
landing.tryText: Answer a question. A wrong answer shows a hint, then you try again.
landing.quizText: Pass the chapter quiz to earn stars and open the next chapter.
landing.rewardsTitle: Points, badges and a class leaderboard.
landing.pointsLesson: for each lesson, the first time
landing.pointsFirstTry: for a quiz answer right first time
landing.pointsHint: for a quiz answer right after the hint
landing.pointsDay: for each day you learn something
landing.pointsRetake: Retaking a quiz only earns points for beating your best score.
landing.leaderboardText: Children see only their own class, with first names and points. Nothing else about anyone is shown.
landing.teachersTitle: See who needs help before the next class.
landing.teachersText: Every answer is checked by the server, so the reports show what children really know.
landing.reportAccuracyText: From each student’s latest try at each quiz.
landing.reportStrugglingText: Below 60% on a topic or chapter, once there are 3 answers to go on.
landing.reportAttentionText: A low quiz score, or no learning for 3 days or more.
landing.reportContentText: Write chapters, lessons and quizzes, preview them, then publish.
landing.footer: Maths practice for CBSE Class 4, based on NCERT Maths Mela.
